reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a novel bulk-alloy intervention, quantitative baseline-relative outcomes, and a decisive temperature-resolved falsification test, whereas B largely repeats the cited nanoflake spray-coating and ethanol-derived carbon-tribofilm study and offers weak support for high-temperature durability. A still requires correction because CaF2 has a fluorite rather than layered structure and is generally more lubricious at elevated temperatures, making its claimed room-temperature-to-600 °C effectiveness uncertain.
